title: Combined Deposit Ceiling per Service Account under Security Deposits
content:
All Security Deposits records of one service account are combined against the ceiling of the tier.

## Ruling

1. The deposits on one service account in assessed, partially paid or held status, taken together as the total of their required amounts, may never exceed the tier's maximum deposit.
2. The deposits of different service accounts of the same member are never combined: each meter is secured by its own deposit.
3. A waived, refunded, applied or cancelled record does not count toward the ceiling.
4. *Retired clause.* The clause providing that a new assessment on a service account that already carries deposits is the computed amount less the required amounts of the deposits already in assessed, partially paid or held status on that account, never below zero, then reduced to the room left under the maximum deposit of the new assessment's tier, none being made when nothing remains, is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

## What counts toward the combined total

| Status of a record on the service account | Counts toward the ceiling |
|---|---|
| assessed | yes, at its required amount |
| partially paid | yes, at its required amount |
| held | yes, at its required amount |
| waived, refunded, applied or cancelled | no |

The combined total is read at a point in time, across every deposit record of the same service account, and never across the member's other accounts.

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A Residential Standard Deposit account carries a held record of $400.00 and a cancelled record of $150.00. The combined total is $400.00, because the cancelled record does not count.
- A member holds a Farm Service Deposit of $700.00 on the farm home and a General Service Deposit of $900.00 on a three-phase bin site. Each account is tested against its own tier's ceiling; the $1600.00 is never added together.

superseded_clauses: A new assessment on a service account that already carries deposits is the computed amount less the required_amount of the deposits already in assessed, partially_paid or held status on that account, never below zero, and it is then reduced to the room left under the maximum_deposit of the new assessment's tier; none is made when nothing remains.
